findings.opportunity: applyXirangPresentationOverlay scans source.diff.entries four separate times per projection update: elementOperationByIdentity, requirementCountsByIdentity, a diffActive .some pass, and structuralEntries (full pass allocating an intermediate array filtered down to kind==='relationship'). The structuralEntries helper and its structuralKinds set have no other consumers.
findings.impact: Collapses four O(n) scans over diff entries into one and removes one intermediate array allocation plus two dead module-level declarations (structuralEntries, structuralKinds). Recomputes on every focus drill, expand/collapse, mode, and selection change.
evidence: likec4/packages/diagram/src/xirang/architectureView.ts:32-34 structuralEntries filters all structural kinds into an intermediate array
likec4/packages/diagram/src/xirang/architectureView.ts:37-45 elementOperationByIdentity makes a full pass over entries
likec4/packages/diagram/src/xirang/architectureView.ts:48-59 requirementCountsByIdentity makes a second full pass over entries
likec4/packages/diagram/src/xirang/architectureView.ts:94-99 applyXirangPresentationOverlay calls both helpers and runs a third .some pass for diffActive
likec4/packages/diagram/src/xirang/architectureView.ts:108-113 relationshipOperations loops structuralEntries(source) and discards every non-relationship kind
grep across likec4/packages/diagram/src: structuralEntries and structuralKinds are referenced only inside architectureView.ts
findings.recommendation: Classify every diff entry in one for loop inside applyXirangPresentationOverlay that updates elementOperations, requirementCounts, relationshipOperations, and diffActive together, preserving the exact predicates and map write order; then delete structuralEntries and structuralKinds.
findings.keyDesign: Single-pass diff classification: one loop over source.diff?.entries ?? [] with branch-on-kind accumulation - element-declaration operations into a Map (last write wins), requirement entries aggregated per identity.split('#')[0] host into XirangRequirementCounts, relationship operations into a Map (first write wins), and a boolean diffActive set by any element-declaration or relationship entry.
preservationConstraints: diffActive must remain true when ANY entry has kind 'element-declaration' or 'relationship' even when entry.operation is not in the operations set
Element operations: only kind==='element-declaration' && operations.has(entry.operation); later entries for the same identity must overwrite earlier ones (last write wins)

Requirement counts: only kind==='requirement' && operations.has(entry.operation); host is entry.identity.split('#')[0]; empty hosts skipped; scenario/property entries ignored; identical 'added,modified,removed' xirangRequirementCounts strings
Relationship operations: only kind==='relationship' && operations.has(entry.operation) and the FIRST entry per identity wins

Node geometry, kind styles, elementId metadata, xirangProjectionMetadata output, opacity values (100/100/45/25), and edge metadata must remain identical for every input, including sources with no diff and kind-only metamodel diffs
implementationOutline: In applyXirangPresentationOverlay, replace the three helper calls, the diffActive .some, and the structuralEntries loop with one for loop over source.diff?.entries ?? [] that populates all four results
Delete elementOperationByIdentity, requirementCountsByIdentity, structuralEntries, and the structuralKinds constant (no remaining callers)
Leave the nodes.map and edges.map sections untouched
Run the targeted vitest spec and typecheck from the validation commands

cd likec4 && pnpm --filter @likec4/diagram typecheck - proves the deleted helpers have no remaining consumers and types stay clean
findings.priorityReason: Ranks first because applyXirangPresentationOverlay recomputes on every projection update (focus, expand, mode, selection changes) while the other candidates run only on selection change or in test code; it also deletes dead code introduced by this change and has full spec coverage for preservation.

findings.opportunity: getArchitectureOverlayModel makes three separate passes over diff entries after the initial filter: the changed/context loop, a second entries.filter that builds the counted array consumed by countOperations, and a third entries.filter that builds the metamodel array. countOperations exists only to consume the second filter's intermediate array.
findings.impact: One classification loop replaces three passes and removes two intermediate array allocations; the overlay model recomputes on every view-source/change/mode selection, and the countOperations helper is deleted. The returned entries/changed/context/counts/metamodel shape is unchanged.
evidence: likec4/packages/diagram/src/likec4diagram/DiagramUI.tsx:76-93 first loop over entries builds changed/context
likec4/packages/diagram/src/likec4diagram/DiagramUI.tsx:95 entries.filter into counted (second allocation) then countOperations makes a second pass
likec4/packages/diagram/src/likec4diagram/DiagramUI.tsx:100-103 entries.filter into metamodel (third allocation, third pass)

findings.recommendation: Accumulate counts and the metamodel list inside the single existing loop over entries (or fold the initial filter into it), then sort metamodel/changed/context exactly as today; delete countOperations and keep the identical return shape.
findings.keyDesign: Single-pass overlay-model assembly: initialize counts to {ADDED:0,MODIFIED:0,REMOVED:0}, collect metamodel entries, and update changed/context in one loop over the structural entries; keep the identical sort orders and the identical returned object fields.
preservationConstraints: counts must come only from element-declaration and relationship entries and always return {ADDED,MODIFIED,REMOVED} with zero defaults

changed must receive every element-declaration identity regardless of operation validity; context must receive before/after parent values (string-typed only) and both non-empty parts of relationship identity split('|'), then remove all changed identities
entries must keep the original diff order; metamodel sort (kind ascending, then identity ascending) and the diagnostics filter must be unchanged
The returned object keeps fields entries, changed, context, counts, metamodel, diagnostics, and the changeDetailsPanel rendering of +N ~N -N and metamodel buttons stays identical
implementationOutline: Merge the changed/context loop, counted extraction, and metamodel extraction into a single loop, accumulating counts and a metamodel array

findings.opportunity: The new e2e test inserts two fixed page.waitForTimeout(400) sleeps between the selecting first click and the details-opening second click. Fixed sleeps always cost their full duration and still race slow CI machines, adding flake risk and ~800ms of dead wall time per project run.
findings.impact: Replacing both 400ms sleeps with an assertion on the observable selection state removes ~800ms of fixed latency per project run and eliminates a timing flake without weakening any assertion.
evidence: test/e2e/semantic-browser-model-view.spec.ts:129-131 first click, fixed 400ms sleep, then second click in the complete-with-diff sequence
test/e2e/semantic-browser-model-view.spec.ts:149-151 identical pattern in the complete-mode sequence

The second click only opens details because the machine requires a selected node: machine.state.ready.idle.ts guards 'click: selected node' plus 'enabled: ElementDetails' route to openElementDetails()
@xyflow/react 12.11.0 NodeWrapper applies class 'selected' to the .react-flow__node element when node.selected is set
findings.recommendation: Replace both await page.waitForTimeout(400) calls with await expect(parent).toHaveClass(/selected/) before the second click.
findings.keyDesign: Event-based waiting: assert the exact observable state the interaction depends on (the node being selected) instead of sleeping a fixed duration.
preservationConstraints: Both click sequences must still perform exactly two clicks at position {x:20,y:20} on the same node locator
All existing dialog assertions stay unchanged
Must remain green on both the desktop and mobile projects configured in playwright.config.ts
No application code changes: this touches only test waiting
implementationOutline: After the first click in the complete-with-diff sequence, replace waitForTimeout(400) with await expect(parent).toHaveClass(/selected/)
Repeat the same replacement in the complete-mode sequence
Run the desktop and mobile Playwright projects for the spec file from the validation command
